subject.title: EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError: session GC deletes file while agent is still running

question: Should the immediate fix add an active-admission guard to cron run-session pruning now, or should this wait for the broader session retention/storage cleanup direction?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the durable repair crosses cron retention, session lifecycle admissions, transcript archiving, and existing storage migration work.

options.title: Guard Cron Pruning Now
options.body: Add an active-work/admission check to the cron reaper so active isolated runs cannot have transcripts archived mid-run, leaving broader storage cleanup to separate work.

options.title: Fold Into Storage Cleanup
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker and solve it only as part of a broader session retention and SQLite cleanup redesign.

options.title: Temporarily Relax Pruning
options.body: Disable or loosen ambiguous cron run pruning until lifecycle ownership is explicit, reducing immediate risk at the cost of retained stale run state.

recommendation.title: Guard Cron Pruning Now
recommendation.body: Add an active-work/admission check to the cron reaper so active isolated runs cannot have transcripts archived mid-run, leaving broader storage cleanup to separate work.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent cleanup lifecycle seam work is closest to the retention and session mutation boundary this decision must preserve.
